education.title: How gold is priced in the UAE
education.description: Understanding the components of a gold price helps you buy and sell with confidence and clarity.

karat.title: Gold is priced by karat purity
karat.description: 24K is 99.9% pure gold — the international benchmark. 22K is 91.6%, 21K is 87.5%, and 18K is 75%. Each gram of lower-karat gold contains less actual gold, so the price per gram is proportionally lower.

spotRate.title: Spot rate converted to AED per gram
spotRate.description: The global spot price is quoted in USD per troy ounce on COMEX. UAE jewellers convert this to AED per gram daily using the official exchange rate. The Dubai Multi Commodities Centre publishes the benchmark used across the UAE.

makingCharges.title: Making charges are added on top
makingCharges.description: Jewellers add a making charge, typically 5–15%, to cover craftsmanship. Simple pieces carry lower charges, while intricate jewellery may cost more. When buying second-hand, you often pay closer to raw gold value.

vat.title: VAT applies to new purchases only
vat.description: The UAE levies 5% VAT on new jewellery sales. Resale transactions between individuals are typically VAT-exempt. Always check whether a listed price includes VAT before comparing.

sell.title: Sell with Confidence

manualReview.title: Manual review by our team
manualReview.description: Every application is personally reviewed by a Dallal Hoolee team member — no automated approvals.

dataSecurity.title: Your data is secure
dataSecurity.description: Documents are encrypted, never shared with third parties, and deleted from our servers after verification is complete.

renewal.title: Renewal not required
renewal.description: Individual verification is permanent. Shop verification renews only when your trade license expires — we remind you in advance.

duration.question: How long does verification take?
duration.answer: Most applications are reviewed within 24 hours. Complex shop applications requiring additional document checks may take up to 48 hours. You will receive an email at every stage — submitted, under review, approved, or if further information is needed.

rejected.question: What happens if my application is rejected?
rejected.answer: If we are unable to verify your documents, you will receive a clear explanation by email. You can resubmit with corrected documents at any time — there is no additional fee for resubmission within 30 days of the original application.

upgrade.question: Can I upgrade from Individual to Verified Shop later?
upgrade.answer: Yes. If you register a trade license after getting Individual Verified, you can apply for Verified Shop by paying the difference (AED 70) rather than the full AED 99. Simply open a support ticket from your dashboard.

refund.question: Is the verification fee refundable?
refund.answer: The fee covers the manual review process conducted by our team. If your application is approved, the fee is non-refundable. If your application is declined and you believe it was in error, contact us within 7 days for a review — if the error was ours, you will be refunded in full.

documents.question: Will buyers see what documents I submitted?
documents.answer: No. Buyers only see your verification badge and the tier (Individual or Shop). The specific documents you submitted are never displayed publicly and are deleted from our systems after verification is complete.

expiry.question: Does verification expire?
expiry.answer: Individual Verified badges do not expire. Verified Shop badges remain active as long as your trade license is valid. We send renewal reminders 60 days before your license expiry date. Renewing is free if the rest of your information is unchanged.

cancel.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
cancel.answer: Yes — you can cancel from your dashboard settings with one click. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period, and you won't be charged again.

trial.question: Is there a free trial for paid plans?
trial.answer: We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans. If you're not satisfied within the first week, contact us for a full refund — no questions asked.

downgrade.question: What happens to my listings if I downgrade?
downgrade.answer: Your active listings are preserved. If you have more listings than your new plan allows, excess listings are paused (not deleted) until you either upgrade again or remove some.

annual.question: How does the Annual billing discount work?
annual.answer: Choosing annual billing locks in a 20% discount for 12 months, billed as a single payment. You save the equivalent of 2.4 months compared to monthly billing.

boosts.question: Do boost purchases count toward my plan quota?
boosts.answer: No — boosts are one-time purchases that work independently of your subscription. You can boost any active listing regardless of which plan you're on.

business.question: Can businesses get custom pricing or invoicing?
business.answer: Yes. Diamond VIP plan holders can request custom invoicing and volume pricing. Contact our business team through the dashboard or email us at business@dallalhoolee.com.
